note: Example contract only; implement or adapt components that the current screens require. Existing library APIs take precedence. High-frequency workspace components added for state/visual contracts; these are templates, not production code.

components.name: UiButton
components.responsibility: Trigger one explicit user action without side effects from rendering
components.a11y: Use button element and semantic type; announce loading, prevent double submission, maintain keyboard focus

components.name: UiIconButton
components.responsibility: Compact icon action with an accessible name
components.a11y: Must have a meaningful accessible name; tooltips do not replace aria-label

components.name: UiField
components.responsibility: Label, hint, input slot, validation, accessible associations
components.a11y: Native label plus aria-describedby and aria-invalid on errors

components.name: UiPanel
components.responsibility: Standard surface for one coherent information group
components.a11y: Static panel is not clickable; interactive card must use a real link or button

components.name: UiDialog
components.responsibility: Modal decision or input without inaccessible custom focus handling
components.a11y: Reuse accessible dialog primitive; focus trap, return focus, Escape and labelled dialog

components.name: UiNavItem
components.responsibility: Navigate while making active and keyboard focus states clear
components.a11y: Use links for navigation, aria-current on active target; do not use div click handlers

components.name: UiPageHeader
components.responsibility: Task-oriented page header with one semantic title, optional incremental explanation, real breadcrumb navigation and contextual actions; never generates decorative eyebrow or generic hero copy by default
components.a11y: Use a semantic heading level appropriate to document structure; breadcrumb is nav not decorative label; maintain predictable reading and tab order; avoid duplicate document H1

components.name: UiStatusBadge
components.responsibility: Display semantic state, not arbitrary accent colors
components.a11y: Color never the only signal; include a meaningful label or icon with accessible text

components.name: UiFeedback
components.responsibility: Represent loading, empty, error and success feedback without inconsistent ad hoc screens
components.a11y: Status uses proper live region when necessary; retry actions are descriptive

components.name: UiSidebar
components.responsibility: Group navigation links, recent objects and footer controls without mixing navigation with activity state
components.a11y: Use semantic nav with labelled sections; links use aria-current where appropriate; collapsed state preserves accessible names and keyboard access

components.name: UiRecentItem
components.responsibility: Represent a recent object independently from the active route; do not reuse primary navigation active styling
components.a11y: Use a link for navigation; status colors need corresponding text or labels; distinguish current workspace from recent history

components.name: UiTopbar
components.responsibility: Provide stable page context and high-value actions without decorative nested containers
components.a11y: Breadcrumb semantics and predictable tab order; sticky header must not cover focused elements

components.name: UiTabs
components.responsibility: Navigate between related in-page views using one primary selected visual and a separate keyboard focus
components.a11y: Use accessible tablist/tab/tabpanel relationships or existing tab primitive; support required keyboard navigation and focus

components.name: UiDataTable
components.responsibility: Compare real rows and columns with consistent alignment, semantic states and performant scanning
components.a11y: Use table headers and sorting semantics; status meaning is conveyed beyond color; horizontal scroll must be discoverable

components.name: UiSearch
components.responsibility: Search within an explicit scope with meaningful query, results and empty-state feedback
components.a11y: Search input has accessible name, keyboard clear behavior and announced result status; shortcuts work only if implemented

components.name: UiSplitPane
components.responsibility: Resize adjacent workspaces while preserving minimum sizes and keyboard operation
components.a11y: Resizable separator includes appropriate accessible name, orientation, keyboard adjustment and safe focus
